conditions: Home page loads with at least one product visible
Each product card has a name, a price, and an image
items.expected: The product list displays at least one card; each card shows a product name, a price, and an image

conditions: Start on page 1 of the product list
items.expected: The page 2 button is activated (navigation to page 2 occurs); a different set of products is displayed compared to page 1

conditions: Navigate to page 2 using the page control
items.expected: The page 2 control becomes the current-page control (aria-current or active class applied to it); the page 1 control is no longer marked as current

conditions: axe-core scan scoped to the product list and pagination navigation
WCAG A and AA rules applied
items.expected: No axe-core violations reported for the scanned region
